pages.title: Never Run Dry
pages.text: Make the factory respond to actual demand.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose a modest target for an available product, remove some stock, and let the configured native request restore it. The gauge must cause the replenishment.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Bind a Factory Gauge, choose its item, destination address and target amount. Request replacement packages when the monitored inventory falls below target.
